en.headline: Judges and judicial officers to receive a 2 per cent pay rise
en.dek: The Executive Council accepted the standing committee's advice. The increase is backdated to 1 April and still needs Finance Committee approval.
body: The Chief Executive in Council has accepted a 2 per cent pay rise for judges and judicial officers in 2026-27, the government said on Wednesday. The adjustment will be backdated to 1 April 2026.

A government spokesman said the Standing Committee on Judicial Salaries and Conditions of Service, chaired by Dr Chan Chun-yan, had based its recommendation on the principle of judicial independence. The committee weighed a basket of factors endorsed in May 2008, including comparisons with private practice, recruitment and retention, retirement benefits, the ban on post-retirement private practice in Hong Kong, the cost of living, and the government's fiscal position. It also took account of the Judiciary's views.
The committee submitted its 2026 review to the Chief Executive on 31 August. The government said it would seek approval from the Legislative Council Finance Committee for the increase.

zh.headline: 法官及司法人員薪酬上調2% 追溯至4月1日
zh.dek: 行政會議接納司法人員薪常會建議，調整追溯至今年4月1日，仍須立法會財委會批准。
body: 政府周三公布，行政長官會同行政會議決定接納建議，在2026至27年度上調法官及司法人員薪酬2%，並追溯至2026年4月1日起生效。
政府發言人表示，由陳鎮仁博士擔任主席的司法人員薪俸及服務條件常務委員會，以維護司法獨立為商議基礎，並平衡考慮行政會議2008年5月通過的一籃子因素，以及司法機構的立場。因素包括與私人執業律師的職責和工作量比較、招聘及挽留情況、退休年齡及福利、離職後不得在港私人執業的規定、生活費用，以及政府財政狀況。
司法人員薪常會於8月31日向行政長官提交2026年薪酬檢討報告。政府表示，會就這次調整向立法會財務委員會申請批准。
